⭐️⭐️⭐️ 3.5 out of 5 stars
I did quite a bit of research before deciding on this clinic for my composite veneers. The offer was 10+10 veneers for 36,000 baht (~USD 1,200), which seemed very reasonable for the service. Here's my full experience, broken down into three parts over a span of about 2.5 months:

Part 1 – First Impressions: Smooth and Fast Process
* Booking was easy and service on the day was prompt. The whole procedure took less than 2 hours.
* I appreciated that they had me sign an acknowledgement form that clearly laid out the “cons” of veneers—like needing to avoid hard foods and taking time to adjust.
* However, the dentist didn’t really explain what was happening during the procedure. I would’ve liked a bit more communication to feel more involved or reassured. In fact, the receptionist went through more details than the dentist (perhaps, the dentist left the admin details to the staff. But just as important is to communicate during the procedure. Maybe it’s just me)
* That said, the staff were friendly and efficient. Overall, I’d give the initial visit a solid 5/5 for service.

Part 2 – The First Chip (Within 1 Week)
* Less than a week later, one veneer chipped—even though I was eating regular food and being cautious.
* Thankfully I was still in Bangkok and could make an emergency appointment quickly.
* They fixed it fast, but afterward I noticed the bite felt a little "off"—like there was a small dent. It wasn’t very visible, so I didn’t say anything immediately.
* I started questioning the durability of the veneers. Why did it chip so easily?
* Also, I couldn’t shake the feeling that I was slightly brushed off during that visit. Maybe because it was a follow-up and not a new sale?
* Still, the convenience and quick fix earns this part a 4.5/5.

Part 3 – After 2.5 Months: Long-Term Concerns
* I’ve been extremely careful—flossing more, brushing often, even picking up mouthwash (which I don’t normally use)
* Despite all that, one upper veneer broke again. At first I thought I was imagining it… but no, it was clearly cracked.
* I also realized the bottom veneers weren’t sealed flush with my real teeth. This left small gaps where food got stuck—and it made me feel self-conscious about bad breath.
* Flossing was frustrating. The jagged edge of the broken veneer kept shredding the thread.
* I scheduled another appointment (again, lucky to be back in BKK), but this time I waited 60 minutes with no update—only to be told the dentist was busy at another clinic.
* The actual cleaning and mending took about 30 minutes. Truth be told, he apologize for the delay, listened to my concerns and offered solution (which was to get a specific floss AND/OR use a water floss. I knowwww, more monetary investment to keeping them clean)
* Prior to the visit, I had asked on WhatsApp about the cleaning cost and was told it would be 800–1,500 baht. I ended up being charged 2,000 baht. That lack of clarity felt a little off.
* Overall, my experience of this place is 3.5/5.

Final Thoughts:
* I acknowledge I’m writing this with some frustration, but my biggest issue is with communication and quality control.
* As an international client, it does feel like once the first payment is done, that’s kind of the end of the relationship.
* I genuinely wanted this to be a long-term solution, but now I’m second-guessing what I can eat and wondering how long these veneers will last.
* That said, the pricing is affordable, and the service is fast and friendly.
* If you’re on a budget and need a quick aesthetic fix, this clinic could work. But if you’re looking for something with more lasting peace of mind, and better aftercare, you might want to consider other options.

I am extremely disappointed with this clinic.

I came in because a veneer had come loose. I was initially given a quote of 25,000 baht for a composite veneer, which I accepted. After examining my tooth, I was then told that the tooth needed to be rebuilt first and that the total cost would be 5,000 baht. This sudden change of plan was confusing, but I agreed to proceed anyway.

Just one week later, the veneer failed again and came completely off.

When I contacted the clinic, no real solution was offered—no refund, no proper repair, not even a simple reattachment of the veneer.

After several messages, the clinic stopped responding and made no effort to offer a solution to my problem.

At this point, I feel the treatment wasn't done properly and the result is unacceptable. I now have to see another dentist and pay again for the same work.

Based on my experience, I cannot recommend this clinic.
